note: Every figure and claim below comes from the published 'Is AI on your power bill?' explainer and its three sources. Headline key words go in [brackets] and turn signal yellow.

slides.headline: Is AI on your [power bill]?
slides.deck: AI data centers need huge amounts of electricity. A Senate report, a bipartisan bill and the companies disagree about who pays for the grid upgrades.

slides.headline: One 100 MW data center can use as much power as about [100,000 homes].
slides.deck: Permanent jobs? About 100, says a report from Senate Democrats.

slides.headline: In Louisiana, one Meta project could add [$8–13 a month] to the average Entergy bill.
slides.deck: That is an estimate, and Meta disputes it. Grid upgrades are often split among everyone with a meter.

slides.headline: Who pays for the [grid upgrades]?

sides.says: None of seven big companies agreed to pay for upgrades built only for them.
They say they pay their direct costs.

slides.deck: A bipartisan Senate bill would make new data centers pay the extra grid costs they add. Who should pay? Tell us.
